offering.name: Legacy Application Modernization
offering.tagline: Retire risky legacy systems without a big-bang rewrite.
offering.summary: incremental modernization of an aging, hard-to-maintain application onto a supported, cloud-native architecture with no loss of business function
capabilities: Assessment of the existing system and modernization roadmap
Data migration with validation and reconciliation
Preservation and improvement of existing business rules
typical_requirements: Replace an unsupported or high-risk legacy application
Preserve existing business rules and data
Move to a supportable, cloud-hosted platform
Reduce ongoing maintenance cost and risk
integrations: downstream systems that consume legacy data
differentiators: Incremental strangler-fig approach avoids risky big-bang cutovers
Business rules are re-verified, not blindly copied
offering.pricing_model: Fixed price per phase, invoiced on milestones
success_metrics: legacy system retired with no loss of function
measurable reduction in maintenance cost and risk

snippets.understanding: You are carrying an aging system that is expensive and risky to maintain, and you need to modernize it without disrupting the business or losing years of data and hard-won business rules.
snippets.solution: We modernize incrementally using a strangler-fig approach: new, cloud-native components take over function piece by piece behind a stable interface, so the old system is retired gradually and safely. Data is migrated with validation and reconciliation, and every business rule is re-verified as it moves.

product_line.name: Custom Application Development
product_line.summary: Bespoke web and mobile applications and modernization of legacy systems.
